rv.q: Jonathan Church's first-rate production has all these. And it is an emotional ordeal – as it should be.

Although Jonathan Church ‘s production amounts to a strong statement of the indestructibility of the human spirit, there’s something neat and tidy about the play that militates against its fierceness.

cn.t: Mixed reviews for this Chichester transfer about Hitler's early victim Hans Litten. Wilton earns praise for her outstanding performance as his mother, though the documentary-style drama divides critics on its dramatic impact.
